svg.text: PART 7: POWER (12 V, 5 V AND 3.3 V)
One adapter feeds everything: 12 V for the motor, 5 V on the top rail from the XL4015, 3.3 V on the bottom rail from the Nucleo.
USB cable to the laptop (power and code)
XL4015 buck converter: 12 V in, 5.0 V out
turn the screw of the blue box
nothing on OUT. A new board
P6, dashed: only when the feeder runs alone
Column map of the whole feeder:
12 V: jack + to column 5 and to XL4015 IN+
5 V: XL4015 OUT+ to the top + rail
3.3 V: Nucleo 3V3 to the bottom + rail
Dashed orange: top + rail to Nucleo E5V,
only when the feeder runs alone
1. Adapter, jack and XL4015 only, OUT wires free.
2. Meter on OUT+ and OUT−. Turn the screw, many
turns, until it reads 5.0 V (4.95 to 5.10 V).
3. Unplug the adapter, then wire OUT to the rails.
No multimeter in the team: borrow one for this step.
Never connect OUT before it reads 5.0 V.
R1 always out: never R1 with the XL4015.
Tests: Nucleo on USB (JP3 on U5V), no P6.
On: USB, then adapter. Off: adapter first.
Feeder alone: P6 in, JP3 on E5V, adapter only.
Logs then: USB after the adapter, out before it.
Check every Nucleo pin label before plugging.
Kibbly hardware · circuit 7 of the circuits by part · wires P1 to P6 in hardware/04_wiring_list.md section 4, V1 to V3 in section 6B, rails R2 to R4 in section 4B
